meta.title: SOUK-SCAN — Food prices in Morocco, shared by people
meta.description: Explore community-reported food prices across Morocco’s 12 regions. Compare fruit, vegetables, meat and poultry, with dated wholesale references where available.

ROOTED IN MOROCCO. POWERED BY PEOPLE.
strings.A little local knowledge goes a long way: A little local knowledge goes a long way. Discover what people are paying for everyday food, before you head to the market.
Choose a category to explore its prices.

strings.Are these official or fixed prices?: Are these official or fixed prices?
strings.No. SOUK-SCAN shares estimates based on: No. SOUK-SCAN shares estimates based on what people report paying in their region. They’re a guide, not a guaranteed price. The interactive souk above uses clearly marked sample prices.
strings.What if there isn’t enough local data?: What if there isn’t enough local data?
strings.The app tells you when there aren’t enou: The app tells you when there aren’t enough recent reports. It doesn’t invent a price. Your contribution can help fill in the picture.
strings.Can I buy food through SOUK-SCAN?: Can I buy food through SOUK-SCAN?
strings.SOUK-SCAN is a price-transparency app. T: SOUK-SCAN is a price-transparency app. The stalls are an interactive way to explore food categories. There’s no checkout or delivery service.
strings.How do I install the Android app?: How do I install the Android app?
strings.Download the APK on your Android phone,: Download the APK on your Android phone, open it, and follow the installation prompts. Your phone may ask you to allow installation from your browser. You can also use the web app without installing anything.
